steps.name: Power Pool Alpha
steps.hint: Utilize data fields with strong raw signals.
steps.task:
Create a single alpha that meets all of the following criteria simultaneously:
  • Uses 8 or fewer operators.
  • Uses 3 or fewer data fields.
  • Achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.0 or higher.
  • Passes other submission criteria, including Fitness, Turnover, Weight Distribution, and the Sub-universe test.
  • Has a self-correlation below 0.5 when compared to the alphas in your Power Pool.

steps.name: ATOM
steps.hint: Fields such as market, sector, country, and currency are considered support data fields. Therefore, using these data fields does not classify the Alpha as multi-dataset Alpha.
steps.answer:
group_normalize(quantile(star_val_industry_rank),group_cartesian_product(exchange,industry))
(Region: GLB, Universe: MINVOL1M, Decay:0, Neutralization: Industry)
steps.task:
Simulate an alpha using just 1 dataset. Check whether the alpha passes the 2-year Sharpe test. If your ATOM Alpha passes all the submission criteria, please submit it.
Criteria:
  • Simulate an alpha using just 1 dataset. Support data fields are not counted as additional dataset.
  • Check prod correlation of simulated alpha and check whether it is below 0.7.

steps.name: Regular Alpha
steps.task: Simulate a regular alpha, and check whether it passes IS-ladder test and prod-correlation test. If your regular alpha passes all the submission criteria, please submit it.
